title: PickMe reward-program valuation defaults
description: Documents the shape of programs.json exactly as decoded by Engine/Sources/CardCopilotEngine/Models/ProgramValuation.swift (ProgramCatalogue and ProgramValuation). Each entry is the catalogue's DEFAULT valuation for one card-catalogue program.programId; OwnerState.valuationsCad overrides any entry key-for-key, and an entry missing here with no owner override means the engine has no honest number for that program. Adding a program to the catalogue used to require a Swift property, a Kotlin property, a schema enum and an owner-state migration; since 2026-08-20 it requires an entry in this file and nothing else, provided its model is one of the four below.

programsVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Not currently load-bearing — SeedLoader.loadPrograms() decodes it but does not gate on it, unlike catalogueVersion. Bump MINOR when adding or revaluing a program; every edit gets a CHANGELOG.md entry (spec §3).

defaults.description: Keyed by card-catalogue program.programId. NOT required to cover every programId. A program with no entry and no owner override has no valuation; Scorer.valueCad currently returns 0.0 for it, which is the defect this contract is the first half of fixing — the second half is excluding the card instead. The current gap is pinned in Engine/Tests/CardCopilotEngineTests/CatalogueIntegrityTests.swift.

basis.description: REQUIRED disclosure. Names where the number came from and states plainly which parts are issuer facts and which are assumptions. Rendered to the owner by the valuation UI — a point value is a forecast of redemption behaviour, never a fact, and an owner has to be able to see and check the assumption being made on their behalf (CLAUDE.md valuation policy).

programValuation.description: A tagged union decoded on `model`, mirroring how Earn is decoded on `type`. The discriminator and the payload share ONE flat JSON object — the payload struct decodes from the same decoder — so no payload may own a key named `model`. This is why CroValuation's own model field is spelled redemptionModel.

centsPerPoint.description: The value used for RANKING. Scorer.valueCad multiplies reward units by this and divides by 100.

floorCentsPerPoint.description: The guaranteed cash-out rate, when the program has one. Drives the floor band, which answers 'does this card still win if I only ever take the cash?'. Omit when the program has no cash floor — Scorer then falls back to centsPerPoint, so a fabricated floor would silently pass off an assumption as a guarantee.

aspirationalCentsPerPoint.description: Published benchmark valuation. Used ONLY as a plausibility ceiling when deciding whether an upside breakeven is worth disclosing — never for ranking. Cite the benchmark and its date in basis.

low.description: Bottom of the plausible redemption range. Disclosure only; not read by Scorer.

high.description: Top of the plausible redemption range. Disclosure only; not read by Scorer.

cashback.title: cashback — a currency already denominated in dollars

cadPerDollar.description: CAD realised per CAD of cash back. 1.0 unless the program discounts redemption.

ctMoney.title: ctMoney — store-locked scrip carrying a usability discount

cadPerUnit.description: Face value in CAD per unit.

optionalUsabilityFactor.description: Haircut for the currency spending at only one retailer. Applied by Scorer only when usabilityFactorApplied is true.

usabilityFactorApplied.description: Whether to apply optionalUsabilityFactor. False values the scrip at face — a deliberate owner choice, not a default.

cro.title: cro — a crypto reward whose CAD value is fixed only on sale

redemptionModel.description: How the reward converts to CAD. NOT the union discriminator above, which is a separate key at the same JSON level; named `model` in owner states written before 2026-08-20.

faceValueFactorIfAutoSold.description: Multiplier applied when CardState.croHandling is "autoSell" — sold on receipt, so face value is realised and there is no price risk to discount.

defaultHeldRiskFactor.description: Multiplier applied otherwise, including when croHandling is unresolved. A risk discount for the gap between earning and selling, not a price forecast.
